simple.meaning: דֶּלֶף (deleph) is a Hebrew word meaning “a dripping.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: דֶּלֶף (H1812) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Proverbs 19:13, with occurrences in Proverbs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דֶּלֶף (H1812) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in דֶּלֶף (H1812) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: דֶּלֶף (deleph) / H1812 is traced through Proverbs 19:13, Proverbs 27:15 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
